description: This source file defines the 'CallerIpTrackingFilter' class, a Spring-based servlet filter that extracts the client's IP address from HTTP request headers, considering various proxy headers, and sets it as a request attribute for tracking purposes within the application.

classes.name: CallerIpTrackingFilter
classes.description: A filter that captures the client's IP address from HTTP headers or remote address and makes it available as a request attribute, conditional on configuration.

methods.name: getClientIpAddress
methods.description: Iterates through known headers to find and return the client's IP address, or defaults to request.getRemoteAddr() if none found.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Main filter method that checks if IP tracking is enabled and accordingly processes the request to capture the client IP.

methods.name: handleClientIp
methods.description: Sets the client IP as a request attribute if found, and ensures attribute cleanup in a finally block.

methods.name: isAsyncDispatch
methods.description: Indicates this filter does not support asynchronous dispatches (returns false).

methods.name: shouldNotFilterErrorDispatch
methods.description: Indicates that error dispatches should be filtered normally (returns false).
